title: Real estate listing automation
headline: Give agents more time for the client conversation.
summary: An independent ChatGPT API workflow for creating property descriptions and automating Facebook Marketplace posting.
question: How can the repetitive work of drafting and publishing property listings take less time?
contribution: I developed an AI-powered listing workflow that uses the ChatGPT API to create property descriptions and automate posting on Facebook Marketplace. I described the project publicly on LinkedIn, and it was featured in The Boston Globe in 2023.
result: The project connected AI-generated listing copy to a practical business workflow. My public project summary describes reduced manual preparation and more daily inquiries, giving agents more time for client interactions.
limits: The public evidence describes the workflow and reported benefits. This case does not present a controlled experiment or verified conversion uplift, and it does not publish customer information, account access, or private source code.
learning: The useful starting point for AI is a specific task: here, turning property information into a listing. A future iteration would measure preparation time, review quality, and publishing reliability against a documented baseline.
